correctness.rationale: Read final RESULT.md. For arbitrary-field 2-step Lie algebra A⊕B⊕(A⊗B), any ideal has projection U onto A⊕B and central K=I∩(A⊗B). Closure is equivalent to H=[U,A⊕B]=P⊗B+A⊗Q⊆K, where P and Q are U projections; consequently K/H is E in (A/P)⊗(B/Q), and the linear lifting map φ:U→Z/K uniquely parameterizes the ideal. Goursat lemma classifies U by dimensions (α,β,c) and a GL_c isomorphism, u=α+β−c. For finite fields the Gaussian and GL products plus E and affine φ choices give the claimed full T enumerator, exactly including non-coordinate ideals. The relative Grassmann/GL_c/vector-bundle tower is smooth geometrically irreducible; dimension sum matches the displayed expression, explicitly only for reduced locally closed strata. One-dimensional ideals must be central since all adjoint operators square to zero, yielding [pr 1]_q and rigidity of {p,r}. Independent RREF all-subspace/bracket enumeration for K1,1 and K1,2 over F2 confirmed dimension multiplicities.
